prompt: My VS Code extension still uses the default tsc build from yo code. I want to switch to esbuild, add proper testing with @vscode/test-cli, and get it ready to publish to the marketplace. Walk me through the migration.

assertions.name: has-esbuild-js
assertions.description: esbuild.js build script with correct entryPoints, bundle, format, platform, external config

assertions.name: has-npm-scripts
assertions.description: package.json has compile, watch, package, and vscode:prepublish scripts

assertions.name: has-external-vscode
assertions.description: esbuild config has external: ['vscode'] to exclude the vscode module

assertions.name: has-vscodeignore
assertions.description: .vscodeignore excludes node_modules, src, and dev files

assertions.name: has-separate-outdir
assertions.description: tsconfig.json outDir differs from esbuild outfile directory (e.g., out/ for tsc vs dist/ for esbuild)

assertions.name: has-parallel-watch
assertions.description: Watch script runs esbuild and tsc in parallel (e.g., npm-run-all -p watch:*)
